parameters.name: invoice_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the invoice to retrieve lien waivers for

items.description: Lien waivers belonging to an invoice

id.description: Unique identifier of the lien waiver. Use as the {id} path parameter to delete the waiver via DELETE /rest/v1.0/projects/{project_id}/lien_waivers/{id}.

company_id.description: ID of the company that owns this lien waiver.

project_id.description: ID of the project this lien waiver belongs to. Matches the {project_id} path parameter used to list and manage waivers.

invoice_id.description: ID of the invoice this lien waiver is associated with. Pass as the invoice_id query parameter when listing or managing an invoice's waivers.

status.description: Current signing status of the lien waiver.

type.description: Classification of the lien waiver, combining its condition (conditional vs. unconditional) and billing stage (progress vs. final).

waiver_date.description: Date the lien waiver was issued, in ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD).

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the lien waiver was last updated, in ISO 8601 format. Null if the waiver has not been updated since creation.

waiver_created.description: Timestamp when the lien waiver was created, in ISO 8601 format. Null if unavailable.

locked.description: Whether the signed lien waiver is locked from the general contractor's view. Unconditional waivers remain locked until released via the unlock endpoint.

user_name.description: Full name of who requested the unlock

last_sign_request.description: Metadata about the most recent sign request for the waiver, or null when no sign request exists

user_name.description: Full name of who requested the signature

requested_at.description: When the sign request was sent

user_name.description: Full name of who unlocked the waiver

sign_url.description: URL a user can open to sign the lien waiver outside of an iframe context. Empty string unless the requesting user is an invoice contact.

iframe_sign_url.description: URL a user can open to sign the lien waiver inside an iframe context. Empty string unless the requesting user is an invoice contact.

pdf_url.description: URL of the current lien waiver PDF document.

reason.description: A human-readable code providing additional detail on the cause of the error.
